Launch date: November 21, 2017
Source: People's Republic of China (PRC)
Launch site: Taiyaun Space Center, China (TSC)

JILIN-01-04 is a Chinese Earth observation satellite designed to record high-definition video and color imagery more than 300 miles [483 km] above the Earth. The three Jilin Earth-imaging satellites launched together — named JILIN 1-04, JILIN 1-05 AND JILIN 1-06 — are owned by Chang Guang Satellite Technology Co. Ltd., a commercial spinoff of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.
